description: This file is a shell script that contains a series of automated tests for Git repository behavior, particularly focusing on directory to symlink merging scenarios, conflict resolution, and integrity of files during merges. It uses functions like test_expect_success, git commands, and test assertions to verify repository states.

methods.name: test_expect_success
methods.description: Defines a test case expecting success with a given label and commands.

methods.name: test_must_fail
methods.description: Runs a command expecting it to fail.

methods.name: test_path_is_file
methods.description: Checks if a given path is a file.

methods.name: test_ln_s_add
methods.description: Creates a symlink and adds it to git.

methods.name: test_done
methods.description: Marks the end of the test script.

methods.name: test -h
methods.description: Checks if a path is a symbolic link.

methods.name: git tag
methods.description: Creates a tag at current commit.

methods.name: git checkout
methods.description: Switches branches or restores working tree files.

methods.name: git reset
methods.description: Resets current branch to a specific state.

methods.name: git clean
methods.description: Removes untracked files from working directory.
